notes.title: Last update before adding new modes - Version 2024.11.30.2134
notes.notes:
This update might not seems big, but for me, it is ! It's a huge work preparing the possiblity to add new modes in the futur. This update is about : User experience, playing solo and preparing the futur, as already stated.

I'm triying my best to not release bug, reason why updates are a bit slower than what you might expect.
Still, there will be bugs ^^


Add: New buttons to align words to guess from the left or from the right of the screen. This new setting is saved.
Add: You can now start to play without being connected to Twitch. To start a session with Twitch enable, you will need to restart the game. When playing solo, the streamer textbox has no delay.
Add : There is now a Startup mode selection screen. It will not appear as long as you have no DLC nor free mode available. But it exists.
Mod: Full screen has been completly redesigned because it was a bit buggy for some streamers.
Mod: Greenscreen is now saved in setting and auto reapears when restarting the game.
Mod: Show game score with the scorebaord screen. (I know it has bug, i'm working on it)
Add: new game option "Pause". When activating a Pause option, steam success are disabled.
Mod: when a board starts, the focus goes on the input textbox.

notes.title: Version 2024.10.26.1646
notes.notes:
New : F9 activates now a green screen. It ugly but efficient for streamers. F4 go backs to normal background.
Fix : Mystery letters were sometimes revealed when it shoudn't.
Fix : Streamer fair-play was not ignoring delay when time left was not long enough causing last tries to be ignored.
Fix : Steam succès display (right side) was not diplayed properly. Also, succus will now be displayed longer.
Fix : Underscores in user names was not displayed under found words.
Fix : Sometimes, score in percentage was not correctly handled by the progress bar.
Fix : Verison number is now displayed correctly on top left corner. Do not crop this part of the game when sending bug report.

notes.title: Version 2024.9.6.2344
notes.notes:
(This patch note has been translated automatically. If you feel there is any problem, feel free to inform me using the discussion sections).


Fixed: The transition between the end of a game round and the score display has been standardized, regardless of the game configuration.
Fixed: The fair-play mode applicable to viewers is now correctly ignored when the remaining time is less than the fair-play mode duration.
Fixed: The ban list and the fair-play player list are now correctly saved.
Fixed: The French dictionary was almost always selected instead of the dictionary defined in the settings. Now, the dictionary set in the settings will always be used.


Added: A very simple short tutorial has been added. It appears only once, on the first launch of the game.
Added: New [X] button to easily close the game, even in full-screen mode.


Changed: The game now launches in full-screen mode by default.
Changed: Added a white halo effect around the characters of some labels to improve readability.
Changed: The game now embeds .Net 6 directly. This should eliminate the need for the player to download and install .Net 6.
Changed: The game initialization process has been improved, especially for language selection.
Changed: Updated translations generated by ChatGPT and provided with the game.
